item.title: Kafka Topic as a Service: Automating GitOps Workflows with Kestra and Jikkou
item.description:
Photo by Barrington Ratliff on Unsplash

This blog post was originally published on Medium

From manual CLI commands to a fully automated, human-in-the-loop provisioning service with Kestra and Jikkou on Aiven’s free Kafka tier.

Managing Apache Kafka resources at scale is one of those problems that starts simple and quickly becomes painful. One day you’re running kafka-topic.sh from your terminal, and the next you’re the gatekeeper for dozens of teams who all need topics, ACLs, and connectors, and of course they needed them yesterday.

item.title: Jikkou: Declarative ACLs configuration for Apache Kafka and Schema Registry on Aiven
item.description:
Photo by iMattSmart on Unsplash

Whether you’ve been running Apache Kafka in production for a few days or a while, you should be aware that creating and managing topics, Access Control, Schemas, etc. by hand is tedious and error-prone.

A better approach is to rely on declarative configuration, revision control and automation to build repeatable and traceable workflows for managing the things of your data streaming platform. In other words, GitOps-style is the way!
